invalid_tables: Some tables do not exist, belong to another restaurant, or are in a locked room
table_busy: Some tables belong to another open order
order_closed: The order is completed, cancelled or merged into another order
table_not_in_order: The table does not belong to this order
last_table: An order must keep at least one table
item_unavailable: Some dishes or combos are discontinued or turned off at this branch
invalid_transition: Cannot change the item to this status
transition_forbidden: You are not allowed to change the item to this status
items_not_served: Some items are not served yet; serve or cancel them before completing
has_served_items: Items have already been served, so the order cannot be cancelled
reservation_closed: The reservation is cancelled, completed, or a no-show
reservation_has_order: This reservation already has an order
staff_not_found: The assigned staff member was not found in this restaurant
not_fully_paid: The order is not fully paid
pending_payments: Some payments are still waiting for confirmation
has_payments: The order has payments; refund them before cancelling
split_successfully: Items moved to the other order
same_order: The source and target orders must be different
source_has_payments: The order has payments or pending transactions; refund or cancel them before merging or splitting
target_not_found: No open target order was found in the same restaurant
invalid_split_lines: Some items are not in the order, are cancelled, or the quantity exceeds what was ordered
no_lines_to_update: No items can be moved to this status
